The hour before bed matters more than total screen time: in a 2025 study of 1,200 kids aged 6 to 9, those using screens in the last 60 minutes fell asleep about 19 minutes later. Three causes: light delays melatonin, games and short video keep kids alert, and screens crowd out wind-down routines. What helped: a fixed screens-off time an hour before bed (weekends too), devices charged outside bedrooms, TV in a shared room, and reading for the last half hour, which fixed sleep onset within two weeks. Bottom line: it's about when, not whether.

For jammy yolks, lower eggs straight from the fridge into gently boiling water for 6.5 to 7 minutes, then straight into an ice bath for at least 5 minutes before peeling. For ramen eggs, marinate the peeled eggs in a soy, mirin and water mixture for at least 6 hours or overnight, so they need to be made tonight to be ready tomorrow.
Action: Set an evening reminder to boil and marinate the eggs.
